description: This Java class 'OfficeWorkbookPopulator' is responsible for generating and populating an Excel workbook with office data, including setting up layouts, lookup tables, validation rules, and default values for a bulk import feature in the Apache Fineract system.

classes.name: OfficeWorkbookPopulator
classes.description: A class that populates an Excel workbook with office data, setting layout, lookup tables, validation rules, and default formulas for bulk import operations.

methods.name: OfficeWorkbookPopulator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the populator with a list of OfficeData objects.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates the provided workbook with office data, setting layout, lookup tables, rules, and defaults.

methods.name: setLookupTable
methods.description: Creates a lookup table within the sheet with office names and IDs.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Defines the header row and configures column widths and header labels.

methods.name: setRules
methods.description: Defines validation rules such as dropdown lists and date constraints.

methods.name: setNames
methods.description: Sets named ranges for lookup purposes in the Excel sheet.

methods.name: setDefaults
methods.description: Populates default formulas in the sheet, particularly for lookup-based IDs.
